How mentorship works

  1. Free 30-minute call. We look at your background, the role you want and what's in the way.
  2. Skills-gap review. You get an honest read on what employers will test you on, and where you stand.

Questions people ask before starting

Do I need a technical background to become a business analyst?

No. Many business analysts come from operations, customer service, finance, HR or project roles. What matters is being able to understand how a business works, ask good questions, and write clear requirements. Mentorship helps you translate the experience you already have into BA language employers recognise.

Who is Flotog BA Insights mentorship for?

Aspiring, junior and mid-level business analysts, plus data analysts and project managers who want to move into or grow within tech. We also work with organisations that want to upskill their BA teams or run digital transformation projects.

Is coaching available outside the UAE?

Yes. We are based in Barsha Heights, Dubai, and coach clients online worldwide.

How much does 1:1 business analyst coaching cost?

A one-hour 1:1 tech career coaching session is AED 400. The first 30-minute consultation is free.

Can you help me prepare for a business analyst interview?

Yes. Interview preparation is one of the most requested coaching topics. You can start with the free BA interview guide, then book a 1:1 session to practise answers to real BA interview scenarios.

Do you coach beyond business analysis?

Yes. Business analysis is the core, with coaching tracks in AI for business analysts and in process improvement and optimisation. Tracks for moving from BA into product and project management roles are coming soon.

What is BA Launchpad?

BA Launchpad is an 8-week small-group programme for people moving into business analysis. Join the waitlist to hear first when the next cohort opens.

Do you train business analysis teams in companies?

Yes. We help organisations improve processes, build BA capability in their teams and run digital transformation that delivers results. Book a free consultation to discuss your team.

Not ready to talk yet? Start with the guide.

The free BA interview guide shows how we teach, with the questions hiring managers actually ask and how to answer them.
